coder_notes: Pan-solid-tumour phase I/IIa. Glioma cohorts (Module 2 and Module 3 Panel 2) are IDH1/2-mutant only; glioblastoma is not named in conditions, title, inclusion criteria or arm labels, so not_glioblastoma. Candidate fields filled for completeness. Regimen is mixed (monotherapy modules and TMZ/ADC combination modules); coded combination. TMZ, T-DXd and Dato-DXd coded soc_backbone as approved partner drugs, though they are not given in every arm. HER2 and HRR markers relate to non-glioma cohorts. Arm labels shortened to the text before the participant description.
